relationships.subject: TLR4 in Nav1.8+ DRG neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, TLR4 expression on Nav1.8+ DRG neurons is both necessary and sufficient for the behavioral response to neuropathic injury.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: We demonstrate that this increase in ATF3 expression is linked to TLR4 expression, as both male and female TLR4 knockouts have lower expression of ATF3 after injury.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: These highly sex and genotype dependent results indicate that endogenous activation of TLR4 on sensory neurons in the DRG of female mice after neuropathic injury initiates cytosolic mobilization of HMGB1.

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Secreted HMGB1 acts on a variety of receptors, namely the receptor for advanced glycation and end products (RAGE), TLR2, TLR4 and TLR5

key_findings: TLR4 on Nav1.8+ nociceptors is necessary and sufficient for early nerve-injury mechanical hypersensitivity in female but not male mice.
Female-specific TLR4-dependent ATF3 upregulation and cytosolic HMGB1 mobilization in Nav1.8+ DRG neurons after SNI.
